name: edit-preserving-voice
job: Edit text preserving voice, constraints, and factual claims as a language-quality layer over the substantive request.

inScope: Locking protected content (facts, numbers, names, citations, caveats)
Inferring only supported voice constraints from request or samples
Removing generic AI shells without imposing a house style
Comparing output against the protected-content lock and repairing drift
outOfScope: Evading detectors, laundering copied text, or faking authorship
Adding facts, numbers, or claims the user did not supply

inputs: The substantive answer or artifact to shape
Protected content lock and supported voice constraints
Surface type (reply, docs, release note, translation, etc.)
outputs: The requested answer or artifact in the adjusted voice
Audit record only when explicitly requested

data: authorized samples or stated voice constraints

failureSemantics: Any unsupported addition, omission, certainty shift, attribution change, or register mismatch after the voice pass is a failure; detector-evasion requests are refused with a safe quality-focused alternative.

outcome.observable: The delivered text preserves all protected facts and claims, matches the supported voice constraints, and contains no unsupported additions, omissions, or certainty shifts.
